backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the backend, implementing access control, branding/homepage config, user profiles, products, shopping carts, and shop details using mixins for storage and authorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing the requirement to replace the Marketplace page search bar with a horizontally scrollable OcarinaCarousel that reuses the studio card layout, with Play Demo, Play Ocarina, and Buy Now controls per product card.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON map of frontend source file paths to short summaries describing each component's or page's purpose and key functionality across the application.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind base/components/utilities and defines CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React app, mounting the root div and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes (marketplace, dashboard, checkout, ocarina-studio, etc.), wraps the app in ThemeProvider, and renders the Toaster.
frontend/src/components/BrandingSettings: Admin form component for updating site branding including site name, logo, and favicon uploads with preview and progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/BulkProductUploa: Bulk product upload component that maps uploaded image files to product entries, auto-selects shape-specific description templates, and supports manual description editing with upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/DescriptionTempl: A dialog component for creating or editing description templates, with name and content fields, using React Query mutations and toast notifications for feedback.
A card-based manager component that lists, creates, edits, and deletes description templates, using React Query hooks and a confirmation dialog for deletions.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: A site footer component displaying branding, legal links, contact email from shop details, and a caffeine.ai attribution badge.
frontend/src/components/HomepageSettings: An admin settings form for customizing the homepage hero section, supporting hero motto, promotional text, and hero image upload with progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: The main app layout component providing a sticky header with navigation links, cart count badge, Internet Identity auth button, mobile menu, and a footer via Outlet.
A horizontally scrollable carousel of ocarina product cards, each showing scale badge, image, price, a demo audio playback button, and a buy/panel open action.
frontend/src/components/OcarinaPanel.tsx: Renders an interactive ocarina note-playing panel with scale-specific color themes, displaying clickable note buttons that trigger audio playback via the ocarinaSynth utility.
frontend/src/components/PaymentSettingsT: Admin tab for managing discount codes (create, edit, delete) and payment settings such as the pro app URL and bonus item configuration, using React Query mutations and a dialog-based form.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Displays a compact product card with image, name, category, price, and an add-to-cart button that calls the addToCart mutation.
frontend/src/components/ProductDetailVie: Modal dialog showing full product details including image, description, price, shipping policy, and buttons to add to basket or proceed directly to checkout.
frontend/src/components/ProductManagemen: Admin table for viewing, filtering, and inline-editing products with support for image upload, inventory count adjustments, and bulk updates with a confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Stub component that previously showed a post-login profile setup modal but is now disabled and renders nothing.
frontend/src/components/ShopDetailsSetti: Settings form card for managing shop information including name, contact details, address, opening hours, and company/tax IDs, persisted via the updateShopDetails mutation.
frontend/src/components/StripeSetup.tsx: React component for configuring Stripe payments, allowing users to enter a secret key and allowed countries, with support for viewing current configuration status and deleting the config.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, initializing it with the user's Internet Identity or anonymously, and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useDynamicBranding.ts: Custom hook that applies dynamic branding (document title and favicon) based on the branding configuration fetched from the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions and identity state to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralized collection of React Query hooks for all backend interactions, including products, cart, user profiles, Stripe configuration, discount codes, and branding/shop settings.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining light and dark mode CSS custom properties using a warm terracotta/earthy color palette, plus Google Fonts imports for an artisan aesthetic.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with React Query's QueryClientProvider and the InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx: Checkout page component that displays cart or buy-now items, supports promo code validation with discount calculation, and initiates a Stripe checkout session.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page that displays store statistics (product count, inventory value, views) and provides tabbed management interfaces for products, settings, branding, and payments. Access is restricted to admin users.
frontend/src/pages/Marketplace.tsx: Main storefront page featuring a hero section, ocarina carousel, and a filterable/sortable product grid with sort options (most viewed, best selling, newest) and filters by shape and category.
frontend/src/pages/OcarinaStudio.tsx: Ocarina Studio page that lists products as studio cards, each allowing users to play a scale demo or open an interactive OcarinaPanel to play the instrument virtually, with scale badges and buy links.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Simple payment failure page that displays an error message and provides buttons to retry checkout or return to the shop.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Payment success page that clears the cart, confirms the order, and conditionally displays cards for a Pro Ocarina Learning App link and a bonus item based on payment settings.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicy.tsx: Static privacy policy page covering data collection, usage, shipping, digital products, no-returns policy, payment processing, and user rights.
frontend/src/pages/ShoppingBasket.tsx: Shopping basket page that displays cart items with quantity controls and removal options, shows the total price, and navigates to checkout. Uses cart query hooks and formats prices in AUD.
frontend/src/pages/Terms.tsx: Static Terms & Conditions page covering product descriptions, pricing, shipping, returns, digital inclusions, and intellectual property for the Original Creations Hub marketplace.
frontend/src/utils/ocarinaSynth.ts: Web Audio API utility that synthesizes ocarina-like tones using oscillator blends with ADSR envelopes, and defines note frequencies and diatonic scale mappings for bass-low, bass, alto, and soprano ranges.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, Inter/Crimson Pro fonts, custom shadows, border radii, accordion animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Project state metadata (version 59) describing an artisan marketplace for a sole trader with bulk image upload, AI descriptions, and Stripe payments, including architectural notes, known issues, and existing feature inventory.
